subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Solve problems in context to 99
source.subtopic: Money problems involving totals and change (weeks 1-4, 7-10)

show.line: Coins can be cents too! Fifty cents, twenty cents, ten cents. Two fifty cent coins make one rand.

rounds.prompt: Count the twenty cent coins in twenties. How many cents?

rounds.story: A pen costs twelve rand. A book costs twenty rand. How much do they cost together?

rounds.prompt: A twenty rand note and a five rand coin. How much money is that?

rounds.story: Musa pays with a fifty rand note. His ball costs thirty rand. How much change does he get?
rounds.praise: Twenty rand change! Fifty take away thirty.

rounds.prompt: Which is worth more, two fifty cent coins or one twenty cent coin?
rounds.praise: Yes! Two fifty cents make one rand.

rounds.prompt: Count the ten rand notes and the five rand coin. How many rand in all?
rounds.praise: Forty-five rand! Ten, twenty, thirty, forty, forty-five.

hints: Add the notes first, then the coins.
Change is what you get back. Take the price away from what you paid.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will add a twenty rand note and a ten rand note.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Twenty rand and ten rand make twenty-one rand!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Twenty and ten make thirty. Thirty rand.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count in tens together. Ten, twenty, thirty. Thirty rand!

parent_line: Can add up money in rands and cents and work out change up to 99 rand.
